consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the release note only announces the new mTLS capability for GitHub App transport; it states no removal, change or breakage of existing behavior, so environments that do nothing keep working as before.

original.statement: Flux 2.7.0 adds support for mTLS on the GitHub App transport for GitRepository, ImageUpdateAutomation, and Provider.

decision.reason: [ev-b335114fe89c] lists "Support mTLS for GitHub App transport" only as a new feature under the release highlights. It does not mention any removal, change to existing defaults, rejection or breakage. An environment that does nothing therefore has no operational consequence that the evidence supports, so "none" (informational) is right. Confidence is low because the one-line excerpt doesn't say outright that the feature is opt-in.
